title: Training API now GA: custom RL and fine-tuning loops
gist: The customer writes the loss or reward, the data and the environment; Fireworks runs the distributed trainer and rollout deployment and serves the result. In November it added adapters served with no idle charge and a preview tool that builds evaluations from production traces. Its customer results are the fullest set published for this lever.
changes: The most complete evidence that tuning an open model buys cost and latency on a narrow task. Its own changelog also shows the catch: tunable base models are added and withdrawn within weeks.
caveats: All results are the vendor's or its customers'. No data volumes, compute or prices. The changelog shows managed reinforcement fine-tuning paused in October and one base model added to training and removed two months later.
